newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS END MOSTLY FLAT IN VERY QUIET TRADE.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS END MOSTLY FLAT IN VERY QUIET TRADE.

text.p: * Finnish bonds end mostly flat with spread over Bunds a shade
wider as Finland lags Bunds' gains by some three basis points,
in almost dead calm trade, dealers say.
* Long end gap over Germany is 23 bp compared to 20 late on
Friday as 2006 benchmark yld ticks one bp lower to 5.88 percent.
* Wait-and-see mood ahead of German IFO this week, Bundesbank
repo and U.S. FOMC meeting on Tuesday and Buba council meeting
on Thursday.
* Markka mostly flat vs marka and seen in 2.9850-3.00 range.
Finnish Bonds ended little
changed on Monday and trade was very calm in wait-and-see
sentiment ahead of U.S. Federal Open Market Committee's meeting
on Tuesday, dealers said.
The long-end gap over Bunds was seen above 20 basis points
near term. "It do not believe it to shrink back below 20 basis
points soon," said one dealer.
Focus was overseas: German M3 and IFO are due this week and
Bundesbank policymaking council to meet on Thursday after a
four-week summer break.
U.S. Fed's FOMC meeting on Tuesday was seen holding rates.
